name: Rage comic
summary: A short comic of 2 to 8 panels drawn in MS Paint with a set of crude faces that show one fixed emotion each. It began on 4chan in 2008 and filled Reddit and 9GAG until about 2015.

philosophy.core_thesis: Tell a small daily frustration in a few crude panels, with stock faces that every reader knows.
design_principles: Divide the canvas into 2 to 6 panels in a grid of 2 columns, each with a 2px black line.
Draw faces as white ovals with a 3px black outline and a few hard strokes; no shading.
Use one stock face for each emotion: rage, joy, smug, disbelief, sadness.
Write dialogue in the panel as plain text at 16px to 20px, with no speech bubble.
Set the scene on a white ground with stick bodies in black lines of 3px.
Keep the drawing flat and rough; keep the lines wobbly at 2px to 3px off straight.
End on the last panel with the strongest face and a one-line result.

layout.grid_mechanics: A 2-column grid of 3 to 4 rows on a 600px wide white canvas; panels of 280px x 220px with 8px gutters.
layout.whitespace_ratio: White fills 100% of the panel ground; faces and stick figures use 30% of each panel.
layout.alignment_rules: Panels read left to right and top to bottom; text sits under or beside the face.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangular panels with a 0px radius and a 2px black border.

font_pairings.note: An open sibling of Comic Sans, the usual face of the form.

hierarchy_rules: Use regular weight; bold marks a shouted word.
Use black text on white; no colour.

color.palette_structure: Black line and white fill, with flat skin tone as the only colour.
color.surface_treatment: Flat white with no texture; slight JPEG noise at the edges.

materiality.surface_simulation: A screen drawing from a mouse in a basic paint program, with hard pixel edges.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px black line round each panel; a 3px outline on shapes.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; faces serve as icons.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Crude faces and stick bodies drawn with a mouse; no shading.

motion.transition_physics: Static strip. A web version reveals one panel at a time each 800ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover frames the panel with a 2px red line.

emotion.target_response: The viewer recognises a small shared annoyance and laughs.

avoid_when: The tone must stay polished or corporate.
The audience wants a long story.

modifiers.how: Keep the crude lines but use one grey-toned face and a single feeling per panel.
Redraw the faces as flat vector shapes with a limited palette of 4 colours.
Replace the panels with one picture and outlined capital captions.

pack.why: A hand-drawn pop family with uneven strokes that match crude panel art.

ground.why: A plain copied white sheet matches the paint-program ground.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none border-2 border-black bg-[#D32F2F] px-5 py-2 text-white hover:bg-black
